questions.question_english: According to Section 7(1) of the RTI Act, 2005, what is the mandatory time limit for providing information if it pertains to the life or liberty of a person?

key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) 48 hours

questions.question_english: 74. Under Article 105 of the Constitution, in which of the following cases do parliamentary privileges NOT protect a Member of Parliament from arrest?
options_english: Civil cases instituted during an active session of Parliament
Civil proceedings initiated forty days prior to a session
Civil proceedings initiated forty days following a session
questions.explanation_english: Under Article 105, parliamentary privilege grants immunity to members from civil arrest during parliamentary sessions and for 40 days before and after sessions.
